paragraphs.text: Sand Warriors are Dominarian creatures controlled by Hazezon Tamar .

Sand Warriors are made of sand , and are modeled after Hazezon himself. He summons them using a short stick topped by a two-faced head, which he twirls between his palms while saying magical verses that mostly aid concentration and that end with "Stand, sons of the sand!"

In the no-longer canon Legend of Jedit Ojanen comic, Sand Warriors were depicted as human, and Hazezon was their leader. Johan described them as not being known for their patience. After Jedit 's monox died, the Sand Warriors surrounded them and used a desert ray , one of their many modes of transportation, to bring Jedit and Johan to Hazezon.
